column2: Clause  7  :  This  clause  inserts  new  sections  7A,  7B,  7C  and  7D  and  the  legal  effect  of  the

column1: insertion of the new sections is to introduce provisions on the followings:-

column2: duration of membership, renewal of membership and the renewal fee;
the Minister to prescribe by regulations the application fee, entrance fee, membership
fee and the renewal fee applicable for each type of membership;
the Honorary General Secretary of the Council to maintain registers of corporate and
the Council to take a decision on cessation of membership of a member of the Institute
who fails to satisfy the Council of his continuous professional development as required.
